user_story: As a customer checking out on https://www.saucedemo.com, I want the checkout information form to enforce required fields so that my order has complete delivery data. Acceptance criteria: after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', adding the backpack via [data-test="add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack"], opening the cart '.shopping_cart_link' and clicking [data-test="checkout"], filling only [data-test="firstName"] with 'Saif' and [data-test="lastName"] with 'Afzal' and clicking [data-test="continue"] shows the error container [data-test="error"] with text containing 'Postal Code is required'.
